name: hero-city-design-alignment
description: Validate reference-aligned HUD, shared depth structure, config-aware performance-mode city overlays, player-controlled combat camera, and hero action controls.

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("PunchWallHUD") local r=g:WaitForChild("PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD") local inventory=r:FindFirstChild("InventoryButton") local shop=r:FindFirstChild("ShopButton") return H:JSONEncode({referenceVisible=r.Visible,status=g:FindFirstChild("HeroStatusDeck")~=nil,nextWorld=r:FindFirstChild("NextWorldCard")~=nil,quest=r:FindFirstChild("QuestCard")~=nil,punch=r:FindFirstChild("ActionPunch")~=nil,jump=r:FindFirstChild("ActionJump")~=nil,inventory=inventory~=nil,shop=shop~=nil,sameMenuRow=inventory and shop and inventory:GetAttribute("MenuRow")=="Shop",legacyControlsHidden=not g.MobileControls.Visible,spawnReveal=g:GetAttribute("SpawnRevealPlayed")==true})

local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local R=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local configModule=R:WaitForChild("PolishConfig") local polishConfig=require(configModule) local overlaySetting=polishConfig.Environment and polishConfig.Environment.CityGroundOverlays local configLoaded=configModule:IsA("ModuleScript") and type(polishConfig)=="table" and type(polishConfig.Environment)=="table" and type(overlaySetting)=="boolean" local cityGroundOverlays=overlaySetting==true local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local blocks=root["Depth Blocks"] local first=blocks.DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02 local transitions,vehicles,road=0,0,0 for _,d in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do if d:GetAttribute("TierTransitionStart")==true then transitions+=1 end end for _,d in ipairs(root.Polish:GetDescendants()) do if d:GetAttribute("VisualRole")=="StreetVehicle" then vehicles+=1 elseif d:GetAttribute("VisualRole")=="HeroCityRoadDetail" then road+=1 end end local environmentConsistent=configLoaded and ((not cityGroundOverlays and vehicles==0 and road==0) or (cityGroundOverlays and vehicles>=3 and road>=8)) local landmarks=root:FindFirstChild("Depth Tier Landmarks") return H:JSONEncode({blocks=#blocks:GetChildren(),transitions=transitions,landmarks=landmarks and #landmarks:GetChildren() or 0,configLoaded=configLoaded,cityGroundOverlays=cityGroundOverlays,vehicles=vehicles,road=road,environmentConsistent=environmentConsistent,role=first:GetAttribute("VisualRole"),edge=first:GetAttribute("EdgeTreatment"),tier=first:GetAttribute("TierName"),contract=root:GetAttribute("DepthBlockContractValidated")})

steps.label: shared depth remains complete while config disables redundant city ground overlays

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local wall=workspace.PunchWallRPG["Depth Blocks"].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02 local root=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if wall and root then root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(wall.Position+Vector3.new(0,0,8),wall.Position) end task.wait(.6) local gui=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD return H:JSONEncode({autoFocus=gui:GetAttribute("CombatCameraActive"),cameraType=workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType.Name})

steps.label: camera remains player controlled near wall

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local r=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local function overlap(a,b) return a.Visible and b.Visible and a.AbsolutePosition.X<b.AbsolutePosition.X+b.AbsoluteSize.X and a.AbsolutePosition.X+a.AbsoluteSize.X>b.AbsolutePosition.X and a.AbsolutePosition.Y<b.AbsolutePosition.Y+b.AbsoluteSize.Y and a.AbsolutePosition.Y+a.AbsoluteSize.Y>b.AbsolutePosition.Y end return H:JSONEncode({questClear=not overlap(g.TargetWallHUD,r.QuestCard),actionsClear=not overlap(g.TargetWallHUD,r.ActionPunch) and not overlap(g.TargetWallHUD,r.ActionJump),statusClear=not overlap(g.TargetWallHUD,r.PowerCard) and not overlap(g.TargetWallHUD,r.CoinsCard) and not overlap(g.TargetWallHUD,r.WallCard)})

steps.label: mobile combat HUD avoids quest status and actions

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local player=game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()[1] local command=game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("PunchWallAutomation") local function read(name) for _,folderName in ipairs({"RPGStats","leaderstats"}) do local folder=player and player:FindFirstChild(folderName) local value=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name) if value and (value:IsA("NumberValue") or value:IsA("IntValue")) then return value.Value end end return 0 end local before={Coins=read("Coins"),Power=read("Power"),Honor=read("Honor"),SpinCredits=read("SpinCredits")} local result=command:Invoke("Spin") local after={Coins=read("Coins"),Power=read("Power"),Honor=read("Honor"),SpinCredits=read("SpinCredits")} local kind=result and result.kind or "" local amount=tonumber(result and result.amount) or 0 local reward=result and result.reward or "" local known={Coins=true,Power=true,Honor=true,BonusSpin=true} local rewardValid=result~=nil and result.ok==true and type(reward)=="string" and reward~="" and known[kind]==true and amount>0 local expectedCredits=math.max(0,before.SpinCredits-1) local stateMutation=false if rewardValid then if kind=="Coins" then stateMutation=after.Coins==before.Coins+amount and after.Power==before.Power and after.Honor==before.Honor and after.SpinCredits==expectedCredits and tonumber(result.coins)==amount elseif kind=="Power" then stateMutation=after.Power==before.Power+amount and after.Coins==before.Coins and after.Honor==before.Honor and after.SpinCredits==expectedCredits and tonumber(result.power)==amount elseif kind=="Honor" then stateMutation=after.Honor==before.Honor+amount and after.Coins==before.Coins and after.Power==before.Power and after.SpinCredits==expectedCredits and tonumber(result.honor)==amount elseif kind=="BonusSpin" then stateMutation=after.Coins==before.Coins and after.Power==before.Power and after.Honor==before.Honor and after.SpinCredits==expectedCredits+amount and after.SpinCredits>=1 and tonumber(result.credits)==after.SpinCredits end end return H:JSONEncode({ok=result and result.ok==true,reward=reward,kind=kind,amount=amount,rewardValid=rewardValid,stateMutation=stateMutation,beforeCredits=before.SpinCredits,afterCredits=after.SpinCredits})

steps.label: weighted hero spin mutates the exact authoritative reward state
